items.note: 3 of 34 Wi-Fi devices have a poor signal: Camera: Parking lot (-81 dBm), Laptop-Guest-7 (-84 dBm), Sensor-Garden (-86 dBm). 5 more are weak but usable
items.hint: Devices far from the router or behind walls drop out and slow down. Try moving the router more centrally and up high, away from metal and thick walls; add a mesh point or access point near the weak devices; and use a cable for things that never move (TVs, PCs, game consoles).
